name: Conch
description: A bank of tuned resonators, like sympathetic strings, that ring at the chord or the key. Put it on a drum loop and the hits come out as pitched, in-key tones; put it on a mix and it adds a singing, harmonic halo. String, Bell and Pipe materials; Decay, Bright, Spread, Width; Hits rings them from transients only, so held notes do not wash them out; In HPF, Drive and Duck. Source: Listen (hears the key and chord, falling back to Key/Scale until it is sure), Key, a Chord by hand, or a progression locked to the song. Click-free chord changes, Freeze, Shimmer and Tune. 8 programs.
author: Groundswell
